chunks: Ali b. Abdullah al-Warraq narrated to us. He said: Sa'd b. Abdullah narrated to us from Muhammad b. Abd al-Jabbar from Muhammad b. Isma'il b. Bazi' from Muhammad b. Abi 'Umayr from Hisham b. Salim from Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad (peace be upon him). He said:

Some of the companions of the Prophet (may Allah bless him and his family) said to the Prophet: O Messenger of Allah, why do we feel toward our children what they do not feel toward us? He said: Because they are from you, and you are not from them.

key_terms.نجد بأولادنا: we feel toward our children (parental affection)

ai.seo_question: Why do parents love their children more than children love their parents in Islam?
ai.summary: A companion asks the Prophet Muhammad why parents love their children more deeply than children love them. The Prophet's answer is profoundly simple: children are the offspring and extension of their parents, but parents are not the offspring of their children. This teaching was narrated through Imam al-Sadiq and highlights the natural bond of parenthood as understood in Islamic tradition.
